name: custom-auth
description: Generic provider for user-configured HTTP AI endpoints (IR <-> vendor wire via translator submodules), key via core-auth.
author: intisy

scripts.build:deps: npm --prefix core-ir install && npm --prefix core-ir run build && npm --prefix openai-translator install && npm --prefix openai-translator run build && npx tsc --project core-auth/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/index.js && npx esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/handler.js && npx esbuild src/driver.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/driver.js
